    Legend:

    • #: Row number within the table.
    • Code: Compact Script 2 experiment code.
    • Tier: Feature-tier group used by the experiment.
    • Model: Model family or model type.
    • Fold: Temporal fold used for validation or backtesting.
    • Trials: Number of Optuna trials associated with the experiment.
    • Prun/Fail: Pruned and failed trial counts.
    • Prog: Training progress indicator.
    • View: Statistic view rendered in the row.
    • Obj: Optuna objective value.
    • S1: Stage-1 score component.
    • S2: Stage-2 score component.
    • S3: Stage-3 score component.
    • PnL (Ret%): Net profit/loss with return percentage.
    • Total Fric: Estimated total friction cost.
    • Total Gross PnL: Gross PnL proxy before friction.
    • Net/trade: Net PnL divided by trade count.
    • Gross/trade: Gross PnL divided by trade count.
    • Positive Edge Retention%: Share of gross positive edge retained after friction.
    • Benchmark RC (Ret%): Risk-constrained benchmark PnL and return.
    • α (RC): Risk-constrained alpha versus benchmark.
    • Benchmark (Ret%): Unconstrained buy-and-hold benchmark PnL and return: 100% of initial equity held long over the full execution range, no risk constraints. Used to compute α (adj).
    • α (adj): Legacy friction-adjusted alpha: gross PnL return (pre-friction) minus the unconstrained buy-and-hold benchmark return (100% equity, no risk constraints).
    • Trades (Entry%): Executed Stage3 trade count; Entry% is the Stage3 model entry-signal rate: the percentage of total Stage3 predictions where the model emitted an entry signal before bot logic.
    • Win%: Winning-trade percentage.
    • Sharpe: Backtest Sharpe ratio.
    • Investor MTM Max DD%: Investor MTM maximum drawdown as a fraction of the peak equity at the drawdown (max_drawdown / running peak).
    • Sortino Daily: Annualized daily Sortino ratio: mean UTC daily MTM return over downside deviation below zero, scaled by sqrt(365).
    • Calmar: Calmar ratio: annualized MTM return divided by the absolute investor MTM max drawdown percentage.
    • Profit Factor Net: Sum of positive net trade PnL divided by the absolute sum of negative net trade PnL.
    • Fees/Gross PnL: Total fees divided by the absolute gross PnL.
    • Turnover Ratio: Turnover notional divided by initial equity.
    • Capital Exposure: MTM position-notional-time integral divided by initial equity times session duration (average share of capital at risk).
    • Entry Total Block Rate: Total blocked entries divided by candidate directional signals.
    • Risk Force-Flat Rate: Risk force-flat closes divided by closed trades.
    • F1 Ent/Mac: Entry F1 and macro F1 scores.
    • JS Div: Jensen-Shannon divergence for prediction distribution drift.
    • WS×Feat: Window size by feature-count profile.
    • Params: Trainable parameter count.
    • BT Prog%: Backtest completion percentage.
    • Runs: Source run tags merged into the logical row.
    • ExpIDs: Experiment database IDs merged into the logical row.
    • Best TrialID (Opt#): Best trial ID with Optuna trial number when available.
    • Best BktID: Best backtest session ID.

    • Aggregate Net PnL: Sum of net PnL across represented folds.
    • Average Net PnL: Arithmetic mean of net PnL across represented folds.
    • Aggregate Return: Chronologically compounded strategy return across represented folds.
    • Aggregate Benchmark RC: Chronologically compounded risk-constrained benchmark return across represented folds.
    • Aggregate Alpha RC: Aggregate return minus aggregate benchmark RC (never the sum of per-fold Alpha RC values).
    • Average Alpha RC: Arithmetic mean of per-fold risk-constrained alpha.
    • Alpha RC Fold Wins: Count of represented folds with positive risk-constrained alpha.
    • Alpha RC Fold Win Rate: Alpha RC fold wins divided by fold coverage.
